description: Search the espresso gear this site tracks. `products` have a live Amazon price and, when at a genuine low, a BUY call computed from their own price history; otherwise no call. Filter by slot (the role a product plays in a setup), free-text words (brand and model names, partial words and small typos are fine), a price band, a brand, or on-sale only. Products we know but cannot price (sold direct by the maker, e.g. Niche, Lelit, Decent) come back in `known_unpriced` with no price and the reason: say so, quote the note, and link the url. When nothing in `products` matches, `alternatives` lists the closest tracked products with live prices and `note` says what was and was not found. Never tell the user the site has nothing; tell them what it has.

brand.description: Only this brand (case-insensitive; "Niche Coffee" finds Niche).

max_price.description: Only products at or under this USD price.

min_price.description: Only products at or over this USD price.

on_sale_only.description: Only products at a good price today (verdict = buy).

query.description: Free-text words to match (any word matches; names and brands rank first), e.g. "niche", "bambino plus", "hand burr", "dual boiler".

slot.description: Restrict to one slot. Omit to search every slot.

name: search_catalog
title: Search the espresso catalog
